requirement: Describe SELECT as a randomized, double-blind, parallel-group, placebo-controlled, event-driven Phase 3b trial of once-weekly subcutaneous semaglutide 2.4 mg plus standard of care versus placebo plus standard of care in people with established cardiovascular disease and overweight or obesity without diabetes.

evidence.text: Protocol Version 7 defines the population, treatment, design, and event-driven follow-up.
SAP v3 restates the primary objective and design.

requirement: Randomize approximately 17,500 participants 1:1 to semaglutide or placebo, with both treatments added to standard of care.

evidence.text: The protocol synopsis gives the target sample and equal allocation.
The SAP confirms 1:1 randomization and the planned enrollment.

requirement: Define the primary endpoint as time from randomization to first major adverse cardiovascular event, comprising cardiovascular death, nonfatal myocardial infarction, or nonfatal stroke.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the three-component MACE endpoint.
The SAP repeats the primary endpoint.

requirement: Prespecify the confirmatory secondary time-to-event endpoints as cardiovascular death, first heart-failure composite event (heart-failure hospitalization, urgent heart-failure visit, or cardiovascular death), and all-cause death.

evidence.text: The SAP lists the three confirmatory secondary endpoints.
Protocol Version 7 defines the secondary outcome hierarchy.

requirement: Use an intention-to-treat treatment-policy estimand for the randomized intervention, collecting and using events regardless of treatment discontinuation, cardiovascular-risk-modifying medication, bariatric surgery, or chronic renal replacement therapy.

evidence.text: The SAP defines the primary estimand and intercurrent-event strategies.

requirement: Use the full analysis set of all randomized participants and analyze them according to randomized treatment for confirmatory efficacy analyses.

evidence.text: The SAP binds confirmatory analyses to the randomized full analysis set.

requirement: Analyze the primary MACE endpoint with a Cox proportional-hazards model using treatment as a fixed factor, report the semaglutide-versus-placebo hazard ratio with two-sided 95% confidence interval, and test superiority against hazard ratio 1.

evidence.text: The protocol specifies the time-to-event treatment comparison.
The SAP specifies the Cox model, estimand, confidence interval, and hypothesis.

requirement: Display Kaplan-Meier cumulative-incidence curves and tabulate participants at risk and event counts over time for the primary and confirmatory time-to-event endpoints.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies time-to-event displays and summaries.

requirement: Base the event-driven design on 1,225 primary MACE events, 90% power, a design hazard ratio of 0.83, one-sided overall alpha 2.5%, approximately 17,500 randomized participants, and assumptions of 2.2% annual placebo MACE and 1% annual loss to follow-up.

evidence.text: The protocol supplies event and enrollment assumptions.
The SAP gives the final group-sequential sample-size calculation.

requirement: Control study-wise one-sided type I error at 2.5% with a Lan-DeMets alpha-spending function approximating O'Brien-Fleming boundaries for one superiority interim at about two-thirds information and the final analysis; include no futility boundary.

evidence.text: The SAP defines alpha spending and interim timing.

requirement: After primary MACE superiority, test cardiovascular death, the heart-failure composite, and all-cause death in the prespecified hierarchical sequence using the remaining confirmatory alpha; otherwise treat later p-values as nonconfirmatory.

evidence.text: The SAP defines gatekeeping for confirmatory secondary endpoints.

requirement: For participants who withdraw or are lost to follow-up, continue efforts to ascertain vital status from indirect sources; censor nonfatal endpoints at last known follow-up when events cannot be obtained, and handle non-cardiovascular death as a competing risk for relevant while-alive analyses.

evidence.text: The SAP specifies censoring and competing-risk handling.

requirement: Assess primary-result robustness with prespecified alternative censoring or competing-risk analyses and supplementary on-treatment analyses that censor after permanent treatment discontinuation plus the allowed risk window.

evidence.text: The SAP lists primary sensitivity and supplementary estimands.

requirement: Conduct prespecified primary-endpoint subgroup analyses with treatment-by-subgroup interaction terms, including demographic, cardiovascular-history, renal-function, body-mass-index, and geographic subgroups, while treating them as supportive rather than multiplicity-controlled claims.

evidence.text: The SAP prespecifies subgroup interaction analyses.

requirement: Summarize adverse events and serious adverse events by randomized treatment, MedDRA system organ class and preferred term, severity, relationship, discontinuation, death, and prespecified safety-focus searches over the defined in-trial and on-treatment observation periods.

evidence.text: The protocol defines safety outcomes and collection.
The SAP defines safety summaries and observation periods.

requirement: Before making SAP-only operational rules binding in a protocol-only plan, obtain confirmation of the exact Cox-model conventions, censoring hierarchy, competing-risk estimators, secondary alpha transfer, on-treatment risk windows, and subgroup model implementation.

evidence.text: The protocol defines the analysis framework but delegates operational details.
The reference SAP contains the later operational choices.

notes: These are confirmed-decision candidates rather than details a protocol-only model should guess.
